# MINTRO

> MINTRO is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) crypto mining app for Windows 10 and 11. It floats on the desktop as a small card, mines a basket of early-stage CPU-mineable coins on an ordinary laptop or desktop, tunes itself to the PC, and pays every share straight to the user's own wallets. MINTRO takes no fee.

- Current version: 0.4.3, for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit); installs per user, no admin rights.
- Engines: XMRig (RandomX, RandomARQ, RandomWOW, GhostRider), cpuminer-opt (yespower, yespowerR16, yescryptR32, power2b, MinotaurX) and, on PCs with a discrete GPU, SRBMiner-Multi (FiroPoW, MeowPoW).
- Coins: the CPU coins on the rplant pool those engines can mine (Monero, Zephyr, Salvium, Raptoreum and newer coins with no market yet), plus coins listed by their projects. The basket only keeps coins that reach the pool's minimum payout within a week on that PC.
- Wallets: one-click wallets for Monero, Zephyr, Salvium and MYT made with each coin's official tools, or paste any address. MINTRO never holds anyone's coins.
- Earnings: small. A laptop mines cents' worth a day, and most new coins never gain value: MINTRO is a way to hold a little of several early coins, not an income. Not financial advice.
- Who makes it: Aitele Research LLP. Source code: https://github.com/aiteleresearch/mintro
